newsitem.title: USA: Fine Air resumes normal service.
newsitem.headline: Fine Air resumes normal service.

text.p: Fine Air Services Inc resumed its normal flight schedule on Friday, a day after one of its DC-8-61F jets crashed on takeoff near Miami International Airport.
"All of our flight schedule is normal," customer service representative Lourdes Fuentes told Reuters.

The cargo carrier has three flights scheduled, routine for a Friday, Fuentes said. The first took off on schedule from Miami for Venezuela Friday morning. The other two will fly to Panama and Costa Rica later in the day, she said.

The cause of Thursday's crash was not known. Witnesses said the Santo Domingo-bound plane appeared to wobble in the air before plummeting to the ground, skidding across a six-lane road and crashing into the parking lot of a shopping mall.
All four people aboard the plane were presumed dead, although only three bodies had been found. Two people on the ground suffered minor injuries.
